subject: AP onboarding: vendor acceptance criteria & commercial path options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@novaworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: AP onboarding: vendor acceptance criteria & commercial path options

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you and the NovaWorks team on the call today. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we keep procurement moving without blocking the pilot. Key items from our call: 

- NovaWorks prefers a PO for software contracts over $10k per quarter; smaller purchases can go on a virtual card.
- Your procurement team has a vendor setup packet (vendor form, W9, insurance certificate) and a standard timeline of ~2–3 weeks for new vendors.
- There was interest in marketplace procurement, but legal indicated a preference for direct vendor relationship for enterprise pilots (no marketplace purchase).

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) I’m attaching our vendor forms and a draft SOW template — could you confirm which documents procurement needs us to complete?
2) If PO is required, can you confirm the PO contact and whether NovaWorks requires a specific remit address or tax info?
3) If virtual card is an option for the pilot, are there card limits we should be aware of (single-transaction and monthly)?

If you want, we can prepare a short MPO (mutual action plan) that maps milestones, procurement steps, and dates. I’ve cc’d Karthik from sales ops and Marissa on the commercial side to help with contract/tax questions.

Thanks again — talk soon.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: vendor-forms.pdf (PDF), redwood-sow-template.docx (DOCX)
From: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@novaworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novaworks.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor acceptance criteria & commercial path options

Thanks, Jordan — appreciate the clear recap. A few procurement specifics to note from our side: 

- For vendors with recurring SaaS spend, Finance requires a PO if the expected spend exceeds $10k in a 30-day period. That fits your typical pilot estimates, so likely we’ll need a PO.
- Our vendor packet includes: completed vendor form, W9, electronic remittance info, and proof of insurance (if applicable).
- We do support virtual card payments for one-off or shorter pilots, but the corporate card program caps single-transaction at $5k unless pre-approved.
- Regarding marketplace: Legal prefers direct agreements for any vendor accessing customer data during pilot. So marketplace route is unlikely for this engagement.

Procurement contact: Tina Park (tina.park@novaworks.com). She handles vendor setup and PO issuance. Once you send over your vendor packet we’ll start the 2–3 week onboarding process. If we can align on a pilot SOW and total expected spend, I’ll flag for expedited review.

Samantha Lopez
Head of GTM Ops | NovaWorks
s.lopez@novaworks.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <s.lopez@novaworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor acceptance criteria & commercial path options

Great — thanks for the clarity, Samantha. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- We will complete the vendor packet today (I attached the files in my first note). Expect vendor-forms.pdf + completed W9 back by EOD tomorrow.
- For the pilot SOW: estimate total not-to-exceed of $12,000 for the 30-day pilot. If PO is required, that will be the number to include.
- Virtual card: noted the $5k single-transaction cap. If your AP team can split payments or temporarily raise the cap for the pilot, we can accept card; otherwise PO is our path.

Next steps I’ll take: 
1) Send the completed vendor packet to Tina Park (cc’d below) by tomorrow.
2) Draft a one-page MPO that lists milestones, success criteria, invoicing schedule, and send for your review by Wed.
3) If Tina needs additional tax/remit info, Karthik will coordinate with our finance contacts.

Are you able to introduce Tina to me directly (or should I send the packet to procurement@novaworks.com)?

Thanks — Jordan

Looping in our billing team notes and one small ask from Finance: 

- For PO processing, we’ll need the exact legal entity name that NovaWorks will be issuing the PO to and the remit address. Please confirm whether the PO should be made out to "Redwood Inference, Inc." or a different entity.
- We can accept virtual card but need the cardholder name and a billing email for receipts; otherwise AP prefers an invoice/ACH.
- If NovaWorks requires vendor-specific insurance naming or SC that differs from our standard packet, flag that now so we can provide an updated certificate.

Jordan — once Tina confirms remit and legal name, I’ll prepare the invoice and the quick vendor packet checklist and send it to her directly.

Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
